name: Hudson Pacific Properties, Inc.
summary: Hudson Pacific Properties, Inc. owns, operates, develops and redevelops top-tier office real estate across high-barrier-to-entry West Coast gateway markets, including the San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle and Vancouver. The company also owns a studio platform unique among publicly traded REITs, comprising one of the largest independent studio operations in Los Angeles, along with an additional studio in New York.
